description: You do not have to give everything your all, some things deserve bare minimum 🥂 #LifeByDesign #stopoverthinking #nervoussystemhealing
transcript: You are not required to operate at full capacity at all times. There are many moments where bare minimum is enough, and most of the time bare minimum is enough. It is so important to interrogate your desires and to question everything when it comes to yourself. The external world does not need your think pieces, but your internal world requires it. We have to know ourselves in order to stop overcompensating to stop getting our value to spaces that quite frankly don't deserve it most of the time. It is so important to think about yourself and focus on how to make this experience better because there's so many things in the external world that will completely ruin your life's experience. And this time on this world is so short.
